id: \rHey, this is my room! Get out!
en: \rHey, this is my room! Get out!
it: \rEhi, questa è la mia cabina! Fuori!

id: \bA man of the sea never turns down an opponent.
en: \bA man of the sea never turns down an opponent.
it: \bUn uomo di mare non rifiuta mai una sfida.

id: \bThe sea is a great place to live.
en: \bThe sea is a great place to live.
it: \bIl mare è un posto fantastico in cui vivere.

id: \bIts just two friends on a cruise together. Nothing strange about that.
en: \bIts just two friends on a cruise together. Nothing strange about that.
it: \bSiamo solo due amici in crociera insieme. Niente di strano.

id: \bI've lived off the coast and trained for years.
en: \bI've lived off the coast and trained for years.
it: \bHo vissuto sulla costa e mi sono allenato per anni.

id: \rMy grandson was around here somewhere. Have you seen him?
en: \rMy grandson was around here somewhere. Have you seen him?
it: \rMio nipote era da queste parti. L'hai visto?
